meta.name: x-article-publisher
meta.description: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文章发布到 X 并自动排版
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写 Markdown 并想一键发布到 X 文章。
copy.tagline_en: Publish Markdown articles to X with auto formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write in Markdown and want to publish to X Articles in one click.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 Markdown 格式的文章转成 X(Twitter)文章编辑器里的富文本,自动填好标题与正文,封面图按需生成或上传,最终只保存草稿、不自动发布。
howto.when: 当你说「发布到 X」「把文章发到 Twitter」「X 文章」等,或想把 Markdown 文件/链接发到 X Articles 时触发。

say.text: 把 /path/to/article.md 发布到 X Articles
say.note: 解析文件、打开编辑器填好内容,保存为草稿。

say.text: 帮这篇文章拟个好标题,再发布到 X
say.note: 文章没有 H1 标题时,Claude 会生成标题再发布。

say.text: 不弹浏览器窗口,直接把这篇文章发布到 X
say.note: 对应 --headless 参数,后台运行不显示窗口。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude converts Markdown articles into rich text in the X (Twitter) Articles editor, fills in the title and body, handles the cover image as needed, and saves a draft without publishing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'publish to X', 'post article to Twitter', 'X article', etc., or want to send a Markdown file/URL to X Articles.

say_en.note: It parses the file, fills the editor and saves a draft.

say_en.text: Draft a good title for this article, then publish to X
say_en.note: If there is no H1 title, Claude creates one before publishing.

say_en.text: Publish this article to X without showing the browser
say_en.note: Uses the --headless flag, runs in the background with no window.
